text:
Clara (Design): Quick check: added a 'preview badge' to alert rule rows showing suppression state + local time hint. Mock: small shield icon + text 'silenced until 07:00 local'. Figma: https://figma.redwood/preview-badge

Dev (PM): Solid. Two asks: (1) make the badge clickable to open the suppression details, (2) change copy to 'silenced until 07:00 (local)'.

Noah (Frontend): Clickable badge ok. Plan: render as a <button aria-haspopup="dialog"> that opens a lightweight flyout with rule name, lastEval and who owns it. Use server flag to fetch full rule only on open to avoid heavy payloads.

Samira (A11y): For screen reader users, ensure the flyout gets role="dialog" and focus trap. Also when the badge appears dynamically (preview update), announce "Channel silenced until 07:00 local" using aria-live polite. Avoid relying on color alone for the shield.

Ops (SRE): Please include a small 'last matched' timestamp in the flyout and whether the preview used draft rules. Also show if the suppression is inherited (team-level) vs channel-specific.

Clara (Design): I'll switch the copy to Dev's phrasing and add an inherit icon. Also will include subtle provenance line: 'applies to: channel / team' and a masked rule id when no permission.

preview-bot: preview built 1 https://preview.redwood/alerts/badge?branch=badge-flyout

Noah (Frontend): I'll implement the flyout and aria patterns, virtualize list if there are many rows. Will add tests for focus and live region announcements.

Samira (A11y): I'll review the implementation once PR lands, focusing on aria-live text, dialog semantics, and color contrast for the badge.

Dev (PM): Nice concise plan. Aim to ship behind feature flag next week.
